checks.finding: REQ-001 through REQ-011 define inspectable schema, byte, diagnostic, approval, protection, routing and verification outcomes. The RT-20260909-002 amendment makes the new Codex adapter directly testable through exact decoded strings, a closed record shape, nonce binding and explicit exit/category expectations. All allowed inputs were read completely; their hashes and the precheck pins match. Reservation sequence 972 extends tip 971, the previous-record hash matches, the recomputed record hash matches the quoted REVIEW_CONTEXT_OK evidence, and identity_unique=yes is present.

AC-001 through AC-046 and their requirement-tagged TEST rows provide coverage for all eleven stated goals. The scoped amendment is traced through the TEST-027-RT002 response fixtures and TEST-032-RT002 cleanup fixtures, with a separate observable native repair-exit record.

Acceptance criteria specify observable validation decisions, canonical bytes and hashes, staged/live artifact states, routing results and cleanup outcomes. The amendment requires exact exit/category assertions and forbidden-success assertions. Its dated cleanup precedence makes absent-after conditional on denial or confirmed cleanup while retaining unconditional sidecar integrity.

Non-goals distinguish A1 schema and verification logic from later registry, resolver, coverage-gate and live cross-runtime work. The amendment limits recovery admission to RT-20260909-002 repair and provenance reviews, expressly excluding ordinary bootstrap, unrelated tasks, integration and quality-gate completion.

The amendment explicitly preserves protective enforcement, independent reviewers, reservations, hashes, schemas, cycle limits and human anchored publication. It disclaims cryptographic host attestation and caller-file forgery detection, requires trusted-session native evidence, and forbids normalization or executor substitution after denial. Investigation's Amendment Re-Review Context supplies the full amendment commit, amended-document fingerprints, dated verbatim approval and referenced-artifact provenance; only phase-sequencing suppression applies. The disclosed historical staged-workflow deletion is not treated as AC-028 satisfaction or permission to restore it.

Approval forgery, weakening, protected publication and hook-evidence risks have planned validation surfaces in AC-014, AC-019, AC-020, AC-023, AC-027 and AC-030 through AC-043. Amendment fixtures cover malformed and duplicate JSON, schema dispatch, strict types, nonce mismatches, extra fields, envelope mutations and legacy compatibility. Recovery exit additionally requires predecessor reviews, original-path suites, both wrappers and fresh native evidence verified at the installed path; synthetic success does not establish activation.
The permitted root-directory existence probe confirmed that domain/ is absent; the check's explicit skip condition applies.
